{{Quote|We've been dreaming lately. Great spitcrete vessels weep dew above the Castle Lands; their engines scorch the air. Dartship swarms shade the sky, humming a song of farewell. We remember the Great Migration, when the lost nests departed Alderaan.|Vector Hyllus|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
The '''Great Migration''' was a period that impacted the [[Killik/Legends|Killiks]] that resided on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] during distant times. This event was marked as a deeply buried primal memory of the [[Hive mind/Legends|hive mind]]. Millennia ago, the Killiks embarked on a great exodus from Alderaan and migrated into unknown [[Realspace/Legends|space]]. Only a handful of nests were left behind that hibernated beneath the [[Castle Lands]] who were completely unaware of the fate of their lost kin.

While moving through space, [[the Colony]] in the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]] were unable to find a single world to support their numbers. Thus, they splintered into a thousand nests that separated and went their own directions in order to prosper. During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], the [[Joiner]] [[Dawn Herald]] [[Vector Hyllus]] felt the primal memory of the Great Migration where he perceived great spitcrete vessels along with swarms of [[Dartship]]s singing the song of farewell. He would later ask [[Cipher Nine]] permission to embark on a pilgrimage to find the lost kin from the Great Migration.
